source_text: You shouldn't be here. Vree doesn't like to be bothered at night. This is the time we meditate.

source_text: 你不该来这里。弗蕾不喜欢晚上有人来打扰，这是我们冥想的时间。

text: We are meditating. Please leave. Come back in the morning.
source_text: We are meditating. Please leave. Come back in the morning.

text: 我们在冥想。请离开，早上再来。
source_text: 我们在冥想。请离开，早上再来。

text: Leave us.

text: 离开这里。
source_text: 离开这里。

text: Have some respect. Don't bother someone while they're meditating.
source_text: Have some respect. Don't bother someone while they're meditating.

text: 请放尊重些，别人冥想时不要打扰。
source_text: 请放尊重些，别人冥想时不要打扰。

text: You Initiates have a lot to learn. Please leave.
source_text: You Initiates have a lot to learn. Please leave.

text: 你们新兵有很多需要学习的东西，赶快离开吧。

text: Don't bother me.
source_text: Don't bother me.

text: 不要打扰我。
source_text: 不要打扰我。

source_text: We are not available during the night. Please see us in the morning.

text: 我们在晚上不能做任何事。请在白天来见我们。

text: It's night. You should be in bed, unless you have guard duty, in which case you should be at your post.
source_text: It's night. You should be in bed, unless you have guard duty, in which case you should be at your post.

source_text: 现在是晚上。你应该在床上睡觉，除非你有守卫任务，但即使是那样你也应该在岗位上。

text: I understand you have something for me?

text: 我认为你有什么东西要给我。

source_text: Me? Nope, sorry. You must have me mistaken for someone else.

text: Uk.
source_text: Uk.

source_text: 呃咳。

text: 非常感谢你带来这些东西。
source_text: 非常感谢你带来这些东西。

text: Um, thank you. Are you okay? Well anyway, it was nice of you to drop these off.
source_text: Um, thank you. Are you okay? Well anyway, it was nice of you to drop these off.

text: 呃，谢谢你。你还好吗？不管怎么说还是谢谢你带来这些东西。
source_text: 呃，谢谢你。你还好吗？不管怎么说还是谢谢你带来这些东西。

text: My research would have been delayed without them. It's good to see we have such a trustworthy Initiate.# I knew getting an outsider wouldn't be a bad decision. If you go see Michael he will have something for you.
source_text:
My research would have been delayed without them. It's good to see we have such a trustworthy Initiate.
# I knew getting an outsider wouldn't be a bad decision. If you go see Michael he will have something for you.

text: 没有这些东西我的研究就不得不停止了。我很高兴我们有一个像你这样值得信任的新兵，我早就知道让一个外来者加入不可能有错的。如果你去见迈克尔他会给你些东西的。
source_text: 没有这些东西我的研究就不得不停止了。我很高兴我们有一个像你这样值得信任的新兵，我早就知道让一个外来者加入不可能有错的。如果你去见迈克尔他会给你些东西的。

Greetings.  I have not seen you here before, are you lost?

text: 你好。我从前没有在这边见过你，你迷路了吗？我能帮忙吗？
source_text: 你好。我从前没有在这边见过你，你迷路了吗？我能帮忙吗？

text: Could you direct me to the library?

text: 你能告诉我图书馆怎么走吗？
source_text: 你能告诉我图书馆怎么走吗？

text: I am looking for Vree.
source_text: I am looking for Vree.

text: 我在找弗蕾。
source_text: 我在找弗蕾。

text: What is this place?
source_text: What is this place?

text: 这里是哪里？
source_text: 这里是哪里？

text: If I was lost I wouldn't be asking an idiot like you for help!
source_text: If I was lost I wouldn't be asking an idiot like you for help!

text: 就算我迷路了，我也不会找你这样的白痴问路！
source_text: 就算我迷路了，我也不会找你这样的白痴问路！

text: I can't believe the kind of people we accept as initiates these# days.  God help us.

I can't believe the kind of people we accept as initiates these
# days.  God help us.

text: 我简直不敢相信，现在我们会接受这样的人来做新兵。上天保佑。
source_text: 我简直不敢相信，现在我们会接受这样的人来做新兵。上天保佑。

text: This is the library.  Here we keep records of all technical data on# weaponry and technology, and, of course, the history of the Brotherhood.
source_text:
This is the library.  Here we keep records of all technical data on

source_text: 这里是图书馆。我们在这里存储所有关于武器和科技的资料，当然，我们也有关于兄弟会的历史。

text: I need a water-chip repaired.  Can you help me?
source_text: I need a water-chip repaired.  Can you help me?

text: 我必须要修理好一个净水芯片。你能帮我吗？
source_text: 我必须要修理好一个净水芯片。你能帮我吗？

text: I'd like to know more about the weapons you make here.
source_text: I'd like to know more about the weapons you make here.

text: 关于你们在制造的武器我想知道更多。
source_text: 关于你们在制造的武器我想知道更多。

text: Is this the place where I would find holo-disks?
source_text: Is this the place where I would find holo-disks?

text: 这里是我能找到磁盘的地方吗？
source_text: 这里是我能找到磁盘的地方吗？

text: Nevermind, thank you for your time.
source_text: Nevermind, thank you for your time.

text: 不用了，谢谢你的帮忙。
source_text: 不用了，谢谢你的帮忙。

text: I'm looking for a big gun to improve my people-killing skills.
source_text: I'm looking for a big gun to improve my people-killing skills.

text: 我在找一支可以提高我杀人技术的大枪。
source_text: 我在找一支可以提高我杀人技术的大枪。

text: I am Vree's assistant.  Vree is over there.
source_text: I am Vree's assistant.  Vree is over there.

text: 我是弗蕾的助手。弗蕾在那边。
source_text: 我是弗蕾的助手。弗蕾在那边。

text: Thank you.
source_text: Thank you.

text: 谢谢你。
source_text: 谢谢你。

text: What is it you do as Vree's assistant?

text: 你作为弗蕾的助手都做些什么呢？
source_text: 你作为弗蕾的助手都做些什么呢？

My area of expertise is the history of the Brotherhood.  It sounds

source_text: 我的专业涉及的是兄弟会历史方面。你的问题似乎是一个制造方面的问题，也许你该去问弗蕾。

text: 我想了解兄弟会的历史。
source_text: 我想了解兄弟会的历史。

You must speak with Vree, the head scribe, about that.  I have more
